messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@stacklift.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom@stacklift.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: STACKLIFT MAP CHECKPOINT — evaluation window & next steps

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for the 11/12 demo. Per our MAP, I attached an updated mutual action plan (StackLift_MAP_v1.3.pdf) and the evaluation schedule (StackLift_Eval_Schedule.xlsx) that reflect the items we discussed. Quick recap and asks for this week's checkpoint: 

Decisions / updates
- Demo follow-up: agreed pilot scope = 2K monthly inference tokens, production-like dataset subset (5k rows).
- Initial eval window: target 4 weeks starting 2026-12-01 (proposed).

Open asks for StackLift
1) Confirm the evaluation start date (we proposed 12/01).
2) Provide the SOC2 evidence packet or a point of contact for procurement to review (we included a stub request in the MAP).
3) Assign a technical owner to run the onboarding test harness (who from your side will own this?)

Internal notes / owners (for clarity)
- Marissa: finalize the pilot credits and pricing addendum (due 2026-11-19).
- Karthik: procurement checklist and DocuSign lock-up for pilot agreement (due 2026-11-23).
- Neha: runtime perf baseline plan and KV caching setup guide (deliverable 2026-11-20).

Please reply inline with confirmations or changes — I'll consolidate and update the MAP this Friday.

Attachments: StackLift_MAP_v1.3.pdf (MAP outline / milestones), StackLift_Eval_Schedule.xlsx (detailed timeline).

Best,
Dylan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@stacklift.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@stacklift.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: STACKLIFT MAP CHECKPOINT — evaluation window & next steps

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attached MAP. A few updates from our side after syncing with ops: 

1) Eval window: we need the start moved one week later to accommodate an internal change freeze — can we begin 2026-12-08 instead of 12/01? That gives us time to provision a test slice.
2) SOC2 evidence: we can provide a redacted packet by 2026-11-24; procurement will need the full vendor questionnaire filled out (Tom will own).
3) Technical owner: Tom Nguyen will run the onboarding test harness and coordinate CI access. He'll start with a pre-check on 2026-11-25.

Quick Q: For the pilot credits, are those applied as usage discounts or as a fixed monthly credit? Marissa, can you confirm?

Will wait for your consolidated MAP update.

Thanks,
Asha
Head of Integrations
StackLift

All —

Confirming the credit approach: we'll provide a monthly pilot credit applied as a billing credit line; details: up to $8k in monthly credits for the 4-week pilot (applies as negative invoice line item). I'll draft the pricing addendum and share for internal review by end of day 2026-11-19.

Notes for procurement: Karthik, please start the vendor questionnaire once Asha confirms the SOC2 stub arrival; I'll coordinate discount language for the addendum.

Also flagging one constraint: if the evaluation start shifts to 12/08 (per Asha), we should move our internal performance baseline run to 12/09 to avoid noisy metrics during their change freeze. Neha — can you adjust the perf run accordingly?

Asha / Tom / team —

Thanks — I've consolidated and updated the MAP and schedule based on the replies. Key decisions and new dates: 

Decisions (confirmed)
- Evaluation start: 2026-12-08 (one-week shift confirmed).
- Pilot credits: $8k monthly credit applied to invoices during pilot (Marissa to deliver addendum 11/19).
- Technical owner: Tom will run onboarding and pre-check (pre-check scheduled 11/25).

Action items (owners & due dates)
- Marissa: share pricing addendum (due 2026-11-19) — DONE (draft attached to MAP v1.3).
- Karthik: vendor questionnaire + DocuSign set-up (due 2026-11-23).
- Neha: performance baseline run & KV cache guide (deliverable 2026-11-20).
- Tom (StackLift): run the pre-check harness and confirm CI access (due 2026-11-25).
- Asha (StackLift): SOC2 redacted packet (due 2026-11-24).

Next-week agenda (11/22 checkpoint call)
1) Review onboarding pre-check results (Tom).
2) Validate perf baseline and caching notes (Neha).
3) Procurement checklist review and sign-off timeline (Karthik).
4) Confirm eval start day 12/08 and finalize DocuSign window.

I linked the updated MAP in Drive and created a HubSpot task under the deal (see links). If no objections, I'll upload the signed MAP to DocuSign template and kick the signature flow on 11/23.

Thanks everyone — I'll run the 11/22 checkpoint call and share minutes.

Best,
Dylan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
